FATHERFOG.Title: Fatherfog
FATHERFOG.Name: Name
FATHERFOG.TraitWorker: Tenacity: When you roll a critical success, you gain 1 Skill Point.
FATHERFOG.TraitPhilosopher:
Rational: When you roll a critical success, nearby party members gain 5 Hope.
Loss of Reason: When you roll a critical failure, nearby party members lose 5 Hope.
FATHERFOG.TraitStranger: Odd Presence: When non-Stranger party members touch you or wake up in your presence, they lose 2 Hope.
FATHERFOG.TraitHunter:
Thrill of the Hunt: When you roll a critical success on a Will check, increase your Will by 1.
Falling Prey: When you Despair, all nearby party members must succeed a Hope Save or Despair as well.

FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningBlack: The color of death, deception, stealth, and solitude.
FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningRed: The color of passion, love, anger, courage, danger, and heightened emotions.
FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningOrange: The color of energy, boldness, brightness, naivety, youth, curiosity, and comfort.
FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningYellow: The color of the obscured sun, hope, attention, warmth, Coin, and fun.
FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningGreen: The color of life, vitality, fertility, speed, and unity with nature and its beasts.
FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningBlue: The color of peace, tranquility, mindfulness, connection, and intelligence.
FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningPurple: The color of royalty, mystery, the unknown, reverence, sophistication, and luxury.
FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningGrey: The color of the Fog at night, solemnity, despair, and the ultimate power of detachment.
FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningWhite: The color of the fool, innocence, childishness, purity, and bliss.
FATHERFOG.CloakMeaningBrown: The color of the commoner, the people, dirt, practicality, grit, and hard work.
FATHERFOG.TraitWorkerTrigger: Tenacity (Worker): +1 Skill Point from critical success.
FATHERFOG.TraitPhilosopherSuccess: Rational (Philosopher): nearby party members gain Hope.
FATHERFOG.TraitPhilosopherFail: Loss of Reason (Philosopher): nearby party members lose Hope.
FATHERFOG.TraitHunterFallingPrey: Falling Prey (Hunter): nearby party members must succeed a Hope Save!
FATHERFOG.TraitStrangerTrigger: Odd Presence: a non-Stranger loses Hope in your presence.
FATHERFOG.OddPresenceHint: Apply −2 Hope to targeted / selected tokens (or nearby). Strangers only.
FATHERFOG.OddPresenceNotStranger: Only Stranger characters can use Odd Presence.
FATHERFOG.DespairRegain: Regain {amount} Hope (rolled {total}). Consult the Guide for the Despair effect.
FATHERFOG.DespairGuideNote: Tell your Guide the exact result. Many Despair effects are private.
FATHERFOG.MustHopeSave: must succeed a Hope Save or also Despair.
FATHERFOG.DeathBodySave: {name} has reached 0 Health. Roll a Body Save ({body}).
FATHERFOG.DeathTakesDesc: You failed the Body Save. The character dies. The Legacy Artifact passes to your next character. You may choose one of Death’s Gifts for the Recently Deceased.
FATHERFOG.DeathGiftNote: See the rulebook (p. 39) for Death’s Gifts.
FATHERFOG.DeathRefuseNote: You may refuse the price and die. If you cannot pay, you also die.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_rebirth: Rebirth – You trick Death. Regain all HP and all Hope. Death now hates you.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_scratch: Scratch – Death only asks for the blood you already spilled.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_faceScar: Face Scar – Your face is flayed open, leaving a thick scar.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_toes: Toes – Death takes 3 of your toes (player’s choice).
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_reflection: Reflection – Mirrors and polished surfaces no longer show your image.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_cheat: Cheat Death – You somehow cheat Death. He will not forget.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_organ: An Organ – Death holds a small organ. You hope it wasn’t vital. (3+ organs = death)
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_tears: Tears – You cannot cry. Emotions show in unsettling ways.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_fingers: Fingers – Death plucks off 3 fingers (not thumbs). Player’s choice.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_ear: Right Ear – Spectacles and some sounds become harder.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_shadow: Shadow – You no longer cast a shadow. Fog creatures always know where you are.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_name: Your Name – No one remembers your name but you; anyone who speaks it loses 10 Hope and forgets it.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_scalped: Scalped – Hair and the flesh holding it are removed. Hats and hoods are your friends.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_nose: Nose – Death tears the nose from your face; sense of smell dulls.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_flayed: Flayed Flesh – Flesh (save face and scalp) is mutilated. Nudity is now repulsive.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_patience: Patience – You are quicker to anger and more impulsive.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_leftFoot: Left Foot – Death carries away your left foot.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_rightThumb: Right Thumb – Your right hand can no longer help itself.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_lies: Lies – When speaking you can only tell the truth; lies become silent mouthing.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_eye: An Eye – A glass eye is expensive; avoiding pirate jokes may be priceless.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_face: Face – Most of your face is torn from your skull. Consider a mask.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_firstBorn: Your First Born – Death demands your firstborn.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_rightHand: Right Hand – Death shakes your hand… and takes it.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_retches: The Retches – Forever nauseated. When you eat, Body Save or lose 1 Body. (stacks)
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_breath: Breath – Lungs never fully function. Lose 1d10 Strength; cough on any 0 digit.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_rightArm: Right Arm – You’re now a lefty.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_leftFemur: Left Femur – Death takes your entire left leg up to the hip.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_spine: Spinal Alignment – Whenever you lose Hope you lose equal Health and vice versa.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_autonomy: Autonomy – Death whispers commands only you can hear. You must obey.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_tongue: Tongue – Death takes your tongue. You can no longer speak intelligibly.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_tremors: Tremors – All your rolls are at Disadvantage.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_warmth: Warmth – Cold to the touch. Fire offers no comfort. (affects Resting)
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_organFail: Organ Failure – Never feel as healthy. Lose 1d10 Strength every morning.
FATHERFOG.DeathPrice_explosion: Spontaneous Explosion – You seem fine… then violently explode after 10 seconds.
FATHERFOG.DrinkOk: You drank. Thirst is cleared (if any).
FATHERFOG.EatOk: You ate. Hunger is cleared (if any).
FATHERFOG.MarkThirst: Marked with Thirst → Disadvantage on all rolls until you drink.
FATHERFOG.MarkHunger: Marked with Hunger → Disadvantage on all rolls until you eat.
FATHERFOG.MarkExhaustion: Marked with Exhaustion → Disadvantage until you sleep at least 4 hours.
FATHERFOG.PerilDisadvantage: You have Thirst, Hunger or Exhaustion: consider rolling with Disadvantage.
FATHERFOG.RestKeepWatchOk: Kept watch for 4 h. +1 Skill Point. (Does not clear Exhaustion.)
FATHERFOG.RestFullNightOk: Full night’s rest: +10 Health, +10 Hope. Exhaustion cleared.
FATHERFOG.RestHalfPick: What do you gain from the half night?
FATHERFOG.RestStatPickHint: Choose which attribute or save increases by +1:
FATHERFOG.RestFeveredOk: Fevered Dreams: −10 Hope. Attempt to remove one malady.
FATHERFOG.RestRoughOk: Rough night: −1 Hope, −1 Health. Exhaustion cleared (you slept 4 h).
